Śrīharṣa
son of Pārthasārathi Miśra (a. of Śabdacintāmaṇi, q by Śrīharṣa in his Amarakhaṇḍana). He was disciple of his grand father Sujana an. Saṅgha Bhaṭṭācārya.
-Amarakhaṇḍana. See under text.
Addl. ms.: Br. Mus. II. 348-50.

Śrīharṣa
alias Harṣa. son of Sūrya, grand son of Śivadāsa an. great grandson of Śrīdhara, a. resident of Mālava, Rāmacandra, a. of Kuṇḍākṛti was his elder brother an. Lakṣmana was younger brother.
-Aṅkayantracintāmaṇi. See under text.

-Vāṇīvilāsa. MD. 16498.

Śrīharṣa
commonly called Harsha, was a. Indian emperor who ruled northern India from 606 to 647 from his capital Kanauj. He was the son of Prabhakara Vardhana an. the younger brother of Rajya Vardhana. Patron of Bāṇabhaṭṭa.
For more ref. see Dharmanatha Sharma, IHQ. XXXII. ii-iii. 1956, p.. 168-69.
For life a. depicted in Harṣa's plays See Brij Narain Sharma, J. of the G. Jha R. I. XIII. Pt.. 1-4. 1956, p.. 143-52.
